one_line: A turn-based dungeon crawler where a human and blind AI familiar solve room puzzles together.
what_it_does: The human explores and describes visible rooms while an external agent uses room-specific WebMCP tools to operate hidden machinery and progress.
leverage_rationale: The agent's changing, room-specific senses and blind spots are the core game mechanic; generic UI driving would not reproduce the structured shared-state co-op reliably.
leverage_evidence: About text defines the familiar as having no eyes and acting only through WebMCP tools.
Text states tools change by room and puzzles require human description plus familiar action.
Frame sheets show repeated annotated player-sees/game states and a transition to an outcome screen.
execution_rationale: The architecture and visual sequence are coherent and show a polished game shell, setup, dungeon states, and apparent outcome, though no readable end-to-end live run is provided.
execution_evidence: Devpost screenshot shows a finished familiar-selection screen with four cards and Bind the familiar action.
Frame sheets show consistent top-down dungeon UI, state annotations, and final modal/result-like state.
About text describes a four-room implementation and separated engine/webmcp/ui layers.
impact_rationale: It offers a credible, memorable co-op game use case for players interested in experimenting with human-agent collaboration.
impact_evidence: Pitch explicitly frames the experience as co-op play between one human and one AI agent.
Rules and progression make both participants necessary rather than adding a chatbot cosmetically.
creativity_rationale: The asymmetric blind-familiar interaction and tool-discovery-driven dungeon progression are a genuinely novel game concept pursued coherently.
creativity_evidence: About text specifies equal-footing human/agent roles with asymmetric information.
Room-specific tool sets make WebMCP part of the puzzle design.
usability_note: Clear setup and game affordances are visible, but the agent workflow depends on a WebMCP-capable environment and is not directly observed end-to-end.
standouts: WebMCP is the game mechanic, not a bolt-on.
advance_reason: High-leverage, unusually creative game with coherent visual and written evidence.

leverage_rationale: Structured slot search and explicit human-only confirmation materially improve safe booking collaboration over an agent clicking a calendar UI.
leverage_evidence: Description lists six page-owned tools including search_slots, hold_slot, list_holds, and request_confirm.
Screenshot visibly shows HUMAN GATE, a held slot with timer, confirm/release controls, and TOOL LOG.
About text states there is no confirm tool and both parties share live state.
execution_rationale: The intermediate hold state, timer, board, gate, and tool log form a coherent central workflow, but no frame sheet or live end-to-end confirmation evidence is included.
execution_evidence: Screenshot shows Friday 4 September 09:00 held with about 180 seconds remaining.
Screenshot shows open/held booking grid and separate tool log.
About text describes static Vercel implementation and in-memory slots.
impact_rationale: Interview and clinic-style scheduling is a concrete audience/problem, and the human gate addresses the consequential risk of accidental booking.
impact_evidence: About text identifies interview/clinic booking as the target use case.
Pitch directly addresses wrong-cell, double-book, and unattended-submit failure modes.
creativity_rationale: Human-gated agent booking is a fresh and practical interaction pattern, though scheduling itself is familiar.
creativity_evidence: Explicit split of agent search/hold and human confirmation.
Visible timer and shared board make the safety model concrete.
usability_note: The visible board, timer, gate, and tool log make responsibility and current state legible.
red_flags: No submitted frame sheets; screenshot is packaging/media preview.
standouts: Strong shared-state evidence in the tool log and hold timer.
advance_reason: A concrete, safety-conscious WebMCP workflow with strong leverage and impact.
